name: queryToStruct
description: Converts a query to a struct, keyed by the values of one column.

params.name: columnKey
params.description: The column whose values become the struct keys.

params.name: structType
params.description: The type of struct to create.

params.name: valueRowNumber
params.description: When true, each value is the row number instead of a struct of the row's data.
